name: CAPITU
description: We introduce CAPITU, a benchmark for evaluating instruction-following capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Brazilian Portuguese. Unlike existing benchmarks that focus on English or use generic prompts, CAPITU contextualizes all tasks within eight canonical works of Brazilian literature, combining verifiable instruction constraints with culturally-grounded content. The benchmark comprises 59 instruction types organized into seven categories, all designed to be automatically verifiable without requiring LLM judges or human evaluation.
